description.value:
Rank 3 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 30 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Weapon's Range
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

Ammo be damned, you pour your ki straight through your weapon. Make a Combo Attack Roll, ignoring all form of bonus to AC from Techniques/Spells. On a hit, you deal your Weapon Damage Die + 5d6 Damage.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon* that you are proficient with.
